En 1861, à Paris, le chirurgien Paul Bro: In 1861, in Paris, the surgeon Paul Broca examines a patient who can only say one syllable: "tan". Wundt distrusts naive introspection: observing oneself must be learned and done under experimental control. He would supervise 185 theses, 70 of them by foreign students, who spread everywhere. En 1932, le psychologue britannique Fred: In 1932, the British psychologist Frederic Bartlett publishes Remembering.
